title: Q-CLEANROOM-boot: a new system does not bring up boot on its own
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** cleanroom run, daily
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation cleanroom --probe boot
**Status:** closed

CLEANROOM-1: a sandbox built from nothing but seed/ and an idea did not bring up `boot` (the bootstrap runs every stage without a blocked one) with zero human steps.

Evidence (2026-11-26T13:44:37Z): constitute: 1 constitution disagreement(s): run_loop.tick_steps: constitution says ['reconcile', 'reap_claims', 'connector_health', 'probe_gates', 'measure', 'score_predictions', 'accrue_trust', 'selfaudit', 'migrate', 'goals', 'unknowns', 'dispatch', 'execute', 'check_plus_share', 'age_sla', 'cost_probe', 'criticality', 'pulse', 'ignition'] but the code has ['reconcile', 'reap_claims', 'connector_health', 'probe_gates', 'measure', 'score_predictions', 'accrue_trust', 'selfaudit', 'migrate', 'goals', 'plan', 'unknowns', 'dispatch', 'execute', 'check_plus_share', 'age_sla', 'cost_probe', 'criticality', 'pulse', 'ignition']

Paths: seed/, doctrine/cleanroom.json, foundation/cleanroom.py.

size: M

**Closing probe:** python3 -m foundation cleanroom --probe boot passes

**Disposition:** fixed (2026-11-26T13:58:24Z, CLEANROOM-1)

**Evidence:** 15 stages, none blocked
